results.title: The geographer accused of being a traitor who made the first modern map of Catalonia
results.description: Josep Aparici i Fins is one of the most important geographers of 18th-century Catalonia, and at the same time, he is surrounded by controversy. During the War of the Spanish Succession, the Austrian authorities commissioned him to map Catalonia, and after the war, he entered the service of King Philip V, who granted him the title of His Majesty's geographer. Furthermore, he was one of the main collaborators in the implementation of the cadastre, a measure that was detrimental to the Catalan economy. But, despite everything, his career has been considered ambiguous.
